description: Archives a flow as its Archive on the Automations page does (archived true): it leaves the flow pickers and the router but is kept, and runs in progress are unaffected. archived false un-archives it. flow_id comes from read('flows'); archive several by calling once per flow. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: set_flow_archived
title: Archive or un-archive a flow
